description: This file defines the AfrDataPoint class, representing a data point for Air/Fuel ratio measurements, including fields for AFR, RPM, engine load, and their corresponding indices. It provides methods for creating instances from raw values and accessing internal data.

classes.name: AfrDataPoint
classes.description: Represents a point of Air/Fuel ratio data with associated RPM and engine load indices, providing data validation, string representation, and access to internal data.

methods.name: AfrDataPoint
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the AFR data point with validation on indices.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Static factory method to create an AfrDataPoint from AFR, RPM, and engine load values, calculating the respective indices.

methods.name: PRESS_RT_32
methods.description: Returns the engine load index (possibly for real-time processing).

methods.name: RPM_RT_32
methods.description: Returns the RPM index (possibly for real-time processing).

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the data point.
